key_dates.label: Summer Solstice
key_dates.commentary: Longest day of the year. Solar panels generate power for over 14 hours, with peak generation around 1 PM Pacific Time.

key_dates.label: Peak Generation Day
key_dates.commentary: Highest daily solar generation of 2024: 209427 MWh. Clear skies and long summer days combine for maximum output.

key_dates.label: Winter Solstice
key_dates.commentary: Shortest day of the year. Solar generation drops dramatically - less than 10 hours of useful sunlight and lower sun angle reduces efficiency.

key_dates.label: Minimum Generation Day
key_dates.commentary: Lowest daily solar generation of 2024: 19977 MWh. Weather conditions like clouds and rain can significantly impact solar output, even more than seasonal variations.
